settings.text: I have sensitive teeth. Will Fluoride Bits work for me?

settings.repere: Paragraphe · Absolutely. Most of our customers find…
settings.text: Absolutely. Most of our customers find relief just by making the switch. Bite helps with sensitivity by removing common triggers like SLS—a harsh detergent that can strip your mouth’s protective lining and leave tissue irritated and exposed. We use a gentle coconut-based surfactant and a low-abrasive formula that cleans effectively without wearing down your enamel. If sensitivity is your #1 concern, our Fluoride-Free Bits contain nHAp, which is scientifically studied to help soothe sensitivity.
